final_confirmation: User reaffirmed Camille and requested documented reasons for every settled naming choice. The glossary records these rationales; historical project spellings do not reopen the decisions.
policy: Use original Latin names when appropriate. Prefer a faithful, more sensible English localization when one exists; original Latin artwork is evidence rather than an absolute spelling requirement.
criteria: Preserve character identity and the Japanese source name or sound.
Consider natural English readability and unintended word meanings.
Use national naming conventions as supporting context without inventing unrelated identities or claiming fictional names are authentic national names.
Decide individually and keep text, nameplates, biographies and graphics consistent.
Preserve source locks, allocations, macro expansion lengths and complete leading/trailing glyphs during implementation.

confirmed_decisions.basis: User explicitly chose to retain the faithful phonetic adaptation; Hoodlum carries an unintended English thug/criminal meaning.
confirmed_decisions.localization_rationale: Retain the faithful Hodram adaptation to avoid the unwanted English thug/criminal meaning of original Hoodlum. No conventional Swedish first-name authenticity is claimed.
Preserve the explicit original Latin Rafael spelling, which is a valid Portuguese name form and fits the established character background. Castor retains the original surname.
Use Joakim from the original Latin artwork, supported by Swedish naming; replace the earlier Joachim spelling. Bergstrom retains the original game spelling.

confirmed_decisions.japanese: マリア・ホアメイ・リー
confirmed_decisions.basis: User explicitly locked in the source-reviewed Maria Huamei Li spelling on 2026-10-06.
confirmed_decisions.localization_rationale: Preserve source Maria and the source name order. Use consistent Mandarin romanization Huamei Li from official Chinese 華梅/李. Huamei is one given name. Resolve mixed Hoamei/Hoa-mei/Huamei and Lee/Li spellings without inventing background or claiming an official English edition spelling.

confirmed_decisions.basis: User explicitly locked in Camille on 2026-10-06. The original Latin artwork supplies a valid name used by men; phonetic reconstruction alone does not justify replacing it, and no concrete unwanted English meaning/readability problem was established.
confirmed_decisions.localization_rationale: Preserve the usable original Latin Camille spelling and source surname Overijssel. Kamil was a defensible phonetic adaptation of カミル, but the explicit source spelling is stronger evidence. National naming conventions provide context without requiring a stereotypically Dutch replacement. The earlier Kamil recommendation is superseded by the user's confirmed Camille choice.

historical_research.V196_original_Latin_cards: Valid source evidence; its absolute naming priority and Hoodlum preference are superseded.
historical_research.V197_three_name_migration: Unregistered research only. The Hoodlum substitution and dependent SC1 macro changes are superseded; its 42-error count describes that historical proposal.
historical_research.Kamil_preference: Earlier recommendation reconsidered: phonetic closeness was given too much weight relative to an explicit usable Latin spelling. Camille is now user-confirmed.

retained_names.basis: Established spelling agrees with original Latin artwork and current translation; no reviewed issue warrants replacement. Preserve Argot as a proper surname.
